0022600121.text: The Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East, 1 game back) visit the Celtics (1-1, 3rd in the Atlantic and 6th in the East, 1 game back), with Chicago 1-1 on the road and riding a W1 streak, while Boston is 1-0 at home and 0-1 on the road. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost 1-2, including a 124-105 defeat in Boston on February 11, 2026, their most recent meeting.
